title: elymus atratus
intro: Elymus atratus, commonly known as Black Needlegrass, is a type of grass native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and skin irritation. The therapeutic actions of Elymus atratus include soothing and calming properties, which may help reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Elymus atratus include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and therapeutic effects.
